warning: Complaint IDs are discovery leads, not verified independent incidents. The list does not add to the three packaged candidate event clusters or to the one cutoff-qualified event.
checks_required_before_event_admission: Confirm the detail page really contains the complaint ID and insurance subject; HTTP 200 alone is insufficient.
Determine whether each ID belongs to a distinct incident rather than a duplicate, follow-up or related episode.
Obtain a contemporaneous anonymous-public visibility witness for the exact pre-outcome content version; displayed submission or approval time alone is insufficient.
Freeze a cutoff 30 minutes after the evidenced visibility time and exclude records and edits after it.
Redact personal, medical and precise monetary details; record exact source-use permission and local version.
Collect independent subsequent observations for a predeclared direction window; a single complaint completion is insufficient.

other_source_categories_requiring_separa.need: contemporaneous visibility witness, source terms, independent event identity and outcome observations
additional distinct insurance-sector incidents with contemporaneous versions and suitable licensed local use
platform access/use scope, valid details, discovery timing and permitted collection before considering benchmark inclusion
